content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Savannah

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and completion of project management education hours—no prior work experience necessary. This makes CAPM ideal for Savannah professionals entering project management roles at organizations like Gulfstream Aerospace, Georgia Ports Authority, and local healthcare systems. Verify your educational background meets PMI requirements before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp course delivered entirely online. Our intensive format covers the CAPM exam domains and project management fundamentals in a condensed schedule. Instruction is delivered by active certified practitioners with real-world expertise, ensuring you gain practical knowledge applicable to your career.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Once coursework is complete, submit your official application to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. This formal step verifies your eligibility and registers you as a candidate. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process so you can move forward with confidence.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources to review domains, practice questions, and build test-taking confidence. Schedule your exam through PMI's testing partner. On exam day, you'll demonstrate your project management knowledge and earn the CAPM credential upon passing.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM is valid for three years. During this cycle, earn professional development units by attending training, conferences, volunteering, or contributing to project management publications and communities. Renew your credential before expiration to keep it active and demonstrate your ongoing commitment to professional development.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.
